Founder Reviews(3) [...] Flux is a game-changing software that has revolutionized the way I interact with my digital devices. As someone who spends long hours working on my computer and browsing on my phone, I've often struggled with eye strain, headaches, and difficulty falling asleep at night. However, since installing Flux on my iOS devices, I've experienced a significant improvement in my overall well-being. The software intelligently adjusts the color temperature of my display based on the time of day, reducing the harsh blue light that can disrupt my natural sleep cycle. With Flux, I can work comfortably for extended periods without the usual eye fatigue, and when it's time to wind down for the night, the warmer, more soothing colors help me relax and fall asleep more easily.
